name: Jonas Kerber
headline: PhD candidate in AI for forests in climate change | CDTM & TUM
summary:
I am looking for a PhD Position in Munich starting February/March 2022.

I want to leverage my Background in Computer Science to research topics that create a sustainable impact. Last, I was working on quantifying the carbon capture potential of managed forests and I am open to explore new domains where my work and research can provide a meaningful impact.

If you know about any positions, please feel free to drop me a message.

positions.title: PHD Candidate
positions.description: Chair of Ecosystem Dynamics and Forest Management

positions.title: Co-Founder & CTO
positions.description:
Pina quantifies and rewards sustainable forestry by combining remote sensing technologies with artificial intelligence.

As a co-founder of the climate-tech startup Pina, I was working on a solution to protect our forests by quantifying and rewarding sustainable forestry. I was developing deep learning solutions for assessing tree carbon based on remote sensing data gathered from drones and satellites. Additionally, worked on forest growth simulations and climate modeling.
